name: Garth One-Eye
description: Heir of Oor-tael, blinded in one eye as a child, who killed Zarel.

description_citations.text: "Zarel Ewine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth arrives in Estark, is befriended by Hammen, and becomes known as One-Eye after winning a magical duel.
timeline.quote: Garth quickly becomes known as One-Eye after winning a magical duel on a public street.

citation.text: "Arena (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth saves the Benalish warrior Norreen from a backstab and confronts her foe's House with her.
timeline.quote: Garth prevents her from being stabbed in the back by her opponent's friend

citation.text: "Arena (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth stirs discord and rioting by joining and abandoning each of the Houses.
timeline.quote: He stirs up discord and rioting in the already dangerous and unstable city.

citation.text: "Arena (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zarel captures and tortures Garth; Hammen, Norreen and Varena free him.
timeline.quote: Garth is captured and tortured by Grand Master Zarel

citation.text: "Arena (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth fights in the Arena under the Fifth House's colors, revealed as a survivor who lost his eye when his family was killed; Norreen leads a mob into the Arena to aid him.
timeline.quote: Norreen leads the crowd as a mob into the Arena to aid him.

citation.text: "Arena (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth is forced to kill Varena with a Psionic Blast when the final battles are made deathmatches.
timeline.quote: Garth is forced to kill Varena with a Psionic Blast

citation.text: "Arena (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth wins the tournament and is whisked away by Kuthuman, who tries to kill him; Garth wounds him and escapes.
timeline.quote: Garth disagrees and wounds him, escaping.

citation.text: "Arena (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Varena is revived; the Houses are destroyed fighting Zarel; Garth returns and kills Zarel with a dagger, then he and Norreen vanish with Kuthuman.
timeline.quote: Garth stabs a dagger in Zarel's chest, killing him.

citation.text: "Arena (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Three years later the city is rebuilt, Varena is Grand Master, and Garth and Norreen return having defeated Kuthuman and sealed his portal.
timeline.quote: Norreen and Garth return, having defeated Planeswalker Kuthuman and sealed the portal he used so he could not return.

citation.text: "Arena (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dacian is captured and made to wear the Stone Brain; Garth arrives furious and is calmed by Rakel.
timeline.quote: The army captures Dacian and puts the helmet on the wizard.

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth visits the army and gifts Greensleeves his spell satchel.
timeline.quote: gifting Greensleeves his spell satchel

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rakel takes command, the army defeats Haakon and Greensleeves planeswalks to Phyrexia; Garth helps defeat Dacian.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves was successful in planeswalking to Phyrexia, bringing some of her friends with her.

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a 2021 retcon, Garth's spark is said to have ignited when he won vengeance against the killer of his kin.
timeline.quote: Garth's planeswalker spark ignited at the moment he won vengeance

citation.text: "Garth", section "On Garth's spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth arrives in Kush and is drawn into its culture of magical duels, allying with the old thief Hammen and earning the name One-Eye in a public duel.
timeline.quote: Through a public magical duel, Garth earned the moniker "One-Eye"

citation.text: "Time of Troubles", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth aids the Benalish warrior Norreen and earns her reluctant gratitude, then stirs unrest by shifting allegiances among the Houses.
timeline.quote: he gained her reluctant gratitude

citation.text: "Time of Troubles", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zarel captures and tortures Garth.
timeline.quote: Captured by Grand Master Zarel, Garth was subjected to torture to extract his motives.

citation.text: "Time of Troubles", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hammen, Norreen and Varena free Garth.
timeline.quote: he was freed by Hammen, Norreen, and Varena

citation.text: "Time of Troubles", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth reveals he is a survivor of the destroyed Fifth House and the son of its slain leader, and enters the Arena under the lost House's banner, sparking chaos.
timeline.quote: He soon revealed his true origins: he was a survivor of the destroyed Fifth House, the son of its slain leader.

citation.text: "Time of Troubles", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zarel and Kuthuman declare the final Festival battles deathmatches to ensure Garth's demise.
timeline.quote: The final battles of the Festival were declared deathmatches by Zarel and Kuthuman to ensure Garth's demise

citation.text: "Time of Troubles", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth is forced to kill Varena in a duel because her warrior's honor bound her to fight to the death.
timeline.quote: Garth was forced to kill Varena in a duel

citation.text: "Time of Troubles", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth wins the tournament; Kuthuman whisks him away and tries to kill him, but Garth wounds the Planeswalker and escapes.
timeline.quote: Garth turned the tables, wounding the Planeswalker and escaping his clutches.

citation.text: "Time of Troubles", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth returns and drives a dagger into Zarel's heart, ending his tyranny.
timeline.quote: ultimately driving a dagger into his heart, ending his tyranny

citation.text: "Time of Troubles", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Norreen embraces Garth and both vanish, drawn away by Kuthuman.
timeline.quote: Norreen embraced Garth — only for the two of them to vanish, drawn away once more by Kuthuman.

citation.text: "Time of Troubles", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Norreen and Garth reappear, having defeated Kuthuman and sealed his portal, then retire to raise their child.
timeline.quote: having defeated Kuthuman and sealed his portal, ensuring he could never return

citation.text: "Time of Troubles", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth reveals his identity as Galin of Oor-tael and, after Kuthuman planeswalks with him, challenges him and steals the power to ignite his own spark.
timeline.quote: Garth challenges him, stealing the power to ignite his own spark.

citation.text: "Time of Troubles", section "Timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zarel gouges out the young Garth's left eye during the Night of Fire, and Cullinarn teleports Garth and his mother away.
timeline.quote: Cullinarn used the last of his power to teleport Garth and his mother far away from the fire.

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After twenty years in exile, Garth returns to Estark under a false name to win the tournament and meet Kuthuman.
timeline.quote: After twenty years in exile, he returned to Estark under the false name of Garth

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth meets Hammen and Norreen, incites riots, is captured, and is rescued from prison by Norreen, Hammen and Varena.
timeline.quote: He was rescued from prison by Norreen, Hammen, and Varena

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zarel rigs the first round so Garth must fight Silmar to the death; Garth wins.
timeline.quote: Zarel rigged the choosing so that Garth was paired with Silmar

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth defeats Kuthuman and uses a spell to steal his ability to planeswalk.
timeline.quote: Garth was successful in defeating Kuthuman

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth willingly gives up planeswalking to live with Norreen.
timeline.quote: he willingly gave up planeswalking to live with the Benalish woman

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth finds leaving his powers behind hard and resumes journeying between planes; Norreen and Hammen are kidnapped to Benalia.
timeline.quote: Norreen and Hammen were kidnapped and brought to Benalia

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth attacks Gull and Greensleeves believing they were the kidnappers, then is calmed and promises never to abandon his family.
timeline.quote: Garth admitted the wrongness of his ways

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth gives his spell satchel to Greensleeves and offers his knowledge of Dominaria to bring Gull's army home.
timeline.quote: giving up his spells' satchel to Greensleeves

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth One-eye returns during the 998th Festival to take revenge for the Night of Fire, starting the Time of Troubles.
timeline.quote: Garth One-eye returned to the city to take his revenge for the Night of Fire

citation.text: "Festival of the Arena", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth One-Eye wins the 998th Festival, with Varena of Fentesk second.
timeline.quote: Garth One-Eye was the victor, with Varena of Fentesk in second

citation.text: "Festival of the Arena", section "Winners". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Twenty years later Hammen becomes involved with Garth One-Eye's plans to challenge Zarel and Kuthuman and realizes Garth is Galin.
timeline.quote: Hammen realized that Garth was Galin, the son of Cullinarn

citation.text: "Hammen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hammen volunteers to fight in the arena in Garth's stead but is stopped by Garth.
timeline.quote: Hammen volunteered to fight in the arena in his stead, but was stopped by Garth.

citation.text: "Hammen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth knocks out and mugs Josega, who cannot take part in the Festival of the Arena.
timeline.quote: was knocked out and mugged by Garth , rendering him unable to participate in the Festival of the Arena .

citation.text: "House of Kestha", section "Other Fighters of House Kestha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth One-Eye won the Festival and Kuthuman took him to his realm.
timeline.quote: When Garth won the Festival, Kuthuman transported both of them to the heart of his realm.

citation.text: "Kuthuman", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth defeated Kuthuman by draining his core mana and took the spell.
timeline.quote: Garth defeated Kuthuman by draining him of his core mana.

citation.text: "Kuthuman", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth sealed the gate against Kuthuman's return with Norreen's help.
timeline.quote: Garth was able to "seal the gate" with Norreen's help

citation.text: "Kuthuman", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Norreen meets Garth in the Arena and falls in love; he promises to give up planeswalking and they retire to Gish with Hammen.
timeline.quote: Here she met Garth, whom she quickly fell in love with.

citation.text: "Norreen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Norreen and Hammen are kidnapped and taken to Benalia while Garth is away.
timeline.quote: Norreen and Hammen were kidnapped and brought to Benalia

citation.text: "Norreen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth reappears, recants his planeswalker spark and returns to the vineyard with his family.
timeline.quote: The wizard recanted his planeswalker spark

citation.text: "Norreen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zarel convinces Kuthuman to destroy Oor-tael; on the Night of Fire he puts out Garth's left eye.
timeline.quote: Zarel scraped out the left eye of Garth

citation.text: "Zarel Ewine", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth returns; Uriah stabs Zarel, Zarel kills Uriah, and Garth kills Zarel.
